rateLimits.note: 1,000,000 quota units a minute per project (Drive API usage limits). Each operation's cost is the units of the Drive method it calls (read: files.get with alt=media, 200; write, delete, move, copy, directory, visibility: an edit method, 50; list: files.list, 100; exists, metadata, checksum: files.get, 5): a lower bound - the adapter may resolve a path with further files.list calls (100 each).
325,000 quota units a minute per user per project (Drive API usage limits), the same costs.

provenance.notes: Google Drive's API, under the Google APIs Terms of Service (last modified 2021-11-09) and the Google API Services User Data Policy (last updated 2024-02-15), read 2026-11-10. Limits: the usage limits page (no date; limits updated 2026-05-01) gives 1,000,000 quota units a minute per project and 325,000 per user per project, method costs of 5 (read), 100 (list), 50 (edit) and 200 (download), a 403 'User rate limit exceeded' or a 429 'Rate limit exceeded' past them, truncated exponential backoff; besides, 750 GB uploaded a day per user and 400,000,000 units a day per project (a billing threshold). The terms forbid circumventing the limits (2(d)). Rights: user data only for user-facing features, never transferred nor sold (User Data Policy: storage 'contract', redistribution 'forbidden'), a privacy policy that documents it; Drive scopes are sensitive or restricted - an annual security assessment for restricted ones; content not cached past its cache headers (5(e)). The key is the OAuth client and the user's refresh token (or a service account). Writes and retries: google/apiclient retries nothing unless its 'retries' option is set (omnidrive sets none), and Guzzle retries nothing - a files.create is not idempotent (Drive allows two files of the same name), so it is sent once, never replayed.
